title: Container: ordinary mailbox projection follow-up after root admission removal
outcome: Normal enabled root sessions currently bypass Engram evaluate/begin because dispatch uses a delegation-child predicate and child binding. Cover direct and queued root turns through shape-aware admission, preserving child authority, disabled project behavior, recovery and fail-closed errors. Add host-path grant/begin/completion and denial-before-provider regressions, run required gates and independent review. No commit/push/install/restart or live Phoenix dispatch.
